title: Francisco León de la Barra, New York, to the Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores, 11 Aug 1913 (catalogue 1463): cipher words in a clear telegram, letter substitution solved from the ciphertext, key frozen on the first half and tested on the second; read in part

documents.shelfmark: CEHM-Carso, Fondo X-1 (Manuscritos de Francisco León de la Barra), X-1.4.310.1
documents.route: F. León de la Barra, New York -> Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores, Mexico

plaintext.source: No decipherment on either copy. The CEHM catalogue has a summary of the telegram (not compared here).

transcription.notes: Pass 1 from the pencil copy (image 0001); pass 2 from the typed copy (image 0002), an independent witness regrouped by the typist. They agree on 215 of 216 cipher letters; the typist dropped one h (kept from the pencil copy).

system.summary: Clear Spanish with cipher words; lower-case letter substitution, 20 cipher letters seen. W is written vv (qq). r stands for h (Washington) and t (latino, reconocimiento); n is t elsewhere. In Bryan rr stands for y. Not the key of the 1912 Mundic telegrams nor of the key sheet X-1.5.466.1.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment on the forms; CEHM catalogue: 'En clave', no translation. Two web searches (12 Nov 2026: 'León de la Barra August 1913 New York Boaz Long telegram recognition Huerta'; '"Mundic" León de la Barra telegrama 1912 clave') found no edition or decipherment of these telegrams; the vetting of 2 Nov 2026 found nothing in DECODE, Tomokiyo or Lasry. Narváez 2019 (SRE book) not read.

conditions.human_role: WAINUT set the task (catalogue 1463) and the rules; AI language-model agents transcribed, solved, froze the key, ran the held-out test, read and checked. No target-specific human intervention. No human palaeographer checked the text.
tools: scripts in this folder (decryption, held-out test, mark check)
simulated-annealing substitution solver with Spanish 4-gram statistics (Project Gutenberg texts)
models: AI language-model agents (WAINUT), viewing the images

solution.what: Images of X-1.4.310.1 and the key sheet X-1.5.466.1 fetched from visor.cehm.org.mx (direct JPG), one at a time, at least 1.6 s apart, no login.
Key sheet X-1.5.466.1 ('Abecedario y su clave', Secretaría Particular del Presidente, to F. L. de la Barra) applied in both directions: no Spanish (scripts/keysheet_test.py).

Simulated annealing on the 216 cipher letters with Spanish 4-grams converged on most restarts to 'long seccion asuntos latinoamericanos departamento estado ...'; the rare letters q, l, s, r settled by hand from the words.

Key frozen from the cipher words of lines 1-6 (18 letters), applied to lines 7-13: 110 of 112 letters right (98.2%), 0 wrong, 2 not in the frozen key (l and s, one each); 14 of 16 groups wholly right.
Decrypted mechanically and read with every departure marked; scripts/check_marks.py passes.

Independent blind review by an AI language-model agent that did not take part in the solve: signs re-read from the scans before opening the transcriptions, scripts re-run, held-out count reproduced, texts read as sentences against the translations. Full agreement with both copies; grade A.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 214 tokens, 20 types, es-modern order 4: reading -2.275 per letter; random keys -6.85 (z 7.5); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.665 (mean -3.782, z 12.2); annealer on the real text -2.194. Verdict: pass.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.284; polyphony 0.005; 2 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.194

outcome.method_basis: Ciphertext-only solve of the cipher words, guided by the clear words around them; frozen on lines 1-6 and tested on lines 7-13.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Counted from the transcription and key.tsv: all 216 cipher letters have a value (scripts/check_marks.py rebuilds the decryption).

texts.label: Telegram of 11 Aug 1913
texts.summary: Boaz Long, chief of Latin American affairs at the State Department, came from Washington to see De la Barra, surely sent by Wilson and Bryan; De la Barra would confer with them on a formal invitation, otherwise he leaves for Europe on Saturday or Wednesday; the ministry should press the case for immediate recognition.
texts.note: 27 cipher words: 24 verbatim (88.9%), 3 marked repairs (vv for W twice, rr for y in Bryan); 26 of 27 if vv for W is taken as the encoder's spelling. No holes. Reading checker on reading_310_sentences.txt: clean share 0.5 (3 of 6 sentences; the holes are names and modern words missing from the period word list).

reading_review.note: Read as sentences against the translation: six coherent sentences with no holes; the marked repairs vv = W (twice) and rr = y (Bryan) stand in the typed copy too. Signs re-read from both copies agree in full, and the held-out count (110/112 letters, 0 wrong) is reproduced.

gaps.item: Bryan: rr for y in the group xgrroz
gaps.detail: no other y in the telegram; the typed copy has the same letters, so it is the encoder's spelling. Marked as a repair.

gaps.item: key values s = x and l = f
